statement: You are given a positive integer n with d digits.
n is an Armstrong number if raising each of its digits to the power d and adding the results gives n back.
Decide whether n is an Armstrong number. The visualizer reports the result as ARMSTRONG or NOT ARMSTRONG.

examples.explanation: 9474 has 4 digits, so each one is raised to the fourth power: 6561 + 256 + 2401 + 256 = 9474.
